sections.content: Friends and family will be wowed when gathering at this spacious and ultra comfortable home. There’s a beautiful new gunite pool, hot tub, large patio, screened in porch, and spacious deck for barbecuing and dining. Interiors feature 2 fireplaces, 2 living spaces with large TVs, fully-equipped kitchen, game room, exercise area, piano, home office, and lots of space to spread out both inside and outside. All of it looks out to the Hudson River where you may spy bald eagles nesting nearby.

sections.title: The space
sections.content:
⭐️ Expansive mid-century mod home with multiple lounging areas

⭐️ Epic views from nearly every room

⭐️ Hotel-style heated pool and patio area with outdoor shower, chaises and lounge area

⭐️ Brand new hot tub

⭐️ Five bedrooms; 1 King, 2 Queens, 2 X-Long Twins, 1 Sofabed

⭐️ Incredible views of Hudson River and Mountains

⭐️ Enclosed porch, upper deck, outdoor firepit

⭐️ Fully appointed kitchen & dining room with service for 12

⭐️ Game room with pool table & fooseball

⭐️ Hi-Speed wifi, 4 flat screen TVs

⭐️ Blue-Tooth Sonos Speakers

⭐️ Two fireplaces: one wood, one gas

⭐️ Washer/Dryer

⭐️ Multi-zone HVAC

⭐️ Work space with adjustable standing/sitting desk

There is something truly special about experiencing the direct river views of the Hudson Valley and witnessing the incredible natural beauty and the magical light that inspired the Hudson Valley School of painting. We're so happy to share this with you in our one-of-a-kind home.

The Hudson House is truly a four-season destination. Whether lounging poolside in summer, witnessing the magnificent colors of Autumn from the hot tub, or drinking hot cocoa in front of a roaring fire in winter...there's no bad time of year to come. The river and its surrounds provide a constant rotation of visual splendor and interest.

sections.title: Guest access
sections.content:
We are conveniently located in the leafy hamlet of Balmville, minutes from downtown Newburgh, and just over the bridge from the Beacon train station.

90 minutes by train, or about a 75 minute drive from NYC. The house is close to the best the Hudson Valley has to offer, including:

- Hiking trails, local farms and distilleries (5 min)
- Beacon (10 min)
- Storm King Arts Park (15 min)
- Dia Beacon Museum (15 min)
- Benmarl & Quartrock Wineries (15 min)
- Woodbury Commons Outlet Mall (25 min)
- New Paltz (30 min)
- Mohonk Preserve (30 min)
- West Point (30 min)

Adam's Farms for great food & fresh produce, as well as many big box shops from Walmart and BJ's to Home Depot and Target are also a 5-10 minute drive away.

Escape to the quiet of nature while staying within minutes of life's conveniences.

sections.title: Other things to note
sections.content:
Well-behaved house trained dogs are welcome for a $100 non-refundable fee. If you are bringing a dog please select that option when making your reservation. One dog is allowed per reservation, unless otherwise approved by host.

And while we allow children, babies and toddlers must be watched carefully in our home as the staircases have a lot of space in between steps and balusters.

No smoking anywhere on the property, except on the pool patio.
No pets w/o approval.
No parties or extra guests outside the maximum occupancy allowed on the listing.
No loud music after 9pm.
No weapons or fireworks.

Pool is only open from May 15th-Oct 15th weather depending. Please check with us ahead of booking if you are close to those dates and want to confirm the pool status.

reviews.comment: Gorgeous views and lots of outdoor space on both floors. The house is very well laid out with one large open central space that ensures great sunlight and views wherever you are and makes it easy to find/talk to everyone. With a well equipped kitchen, a fireplace on each floor, a hot tub right outside the living room, and a basket full of blankets, Garrett's place seems perfectly equipped for a comfortable stay.

Our group required all five bedrooms but that meant every adult or couple had their own space. It was wonderful- everyone felt "treated" in the beautiful home. We did takeout Thai food on Friday and we cooked a family style dinner on Saturday and we felt it was a perfect opportunity to share an early Thanksgiving dinner. Many thanks for offering your spacious, lovely home!

My family and I had an amazing stay! It was the perfect space for all of us with tons to do. The views were spectacular. We felt at home and will absolutely be coming back. Thanks for such a memorable time!
Great stay! Would love to come back.
Excellent stay, a lovely space for all of us to gather - beautiful surroundings as well :)

6 of us slept comfortably in this spacious home, more than enough room for everybody & not to be on top of each other, but the down side of the space is that its on 2 levels, the stairs to get to the lower level of the house & to get down to the beautiful pool & fire pit area, if you have somebody who has difficulty with their legs like my elderly mother, they won't be able to enjoy the lower level of house. The views of the Hudson River are spectacular & unobtrusive from any level of the house, my mother enjoyed sitting in the beautiful & comfortable screened in porch & soaked up the panoramic views. The bathrooms are dated, but fits the retro vibe of the house, which is tastefully decorated. Also I have to mention, I couldn't figure out why there were earplugs in each bathroom, soon enough we figured out trains run day & night blowing it's horn at crossings, it takes a little getting used too. But overall, we loved the house with all it's character & views, it did not disappoint !!!
Great house and service.

The house was absolutely spotless and beautiful decorated, and the Hudson River view was amazing. The house was pet friendly and our dog really enjoyed the outdoor space.
The host was attentive and make sure everything was in order for our arrival.
We really enjoyed our stay!!
This is by far one of our favorite places to stay near the city. The view and scenery is unreal, and the hosts are always incredibly easy to deal with. Can’t wait for our next visit.!

My family and I had the most incredible stay at this stunning mid-century modern gem! The property is a perfect blend of vintage charm and modern luxury, fully stocked with everything you could possibly need. The views of the Hudson River are absolutely breathtaking, offering a serene and picturesque backdrop to our stay.
One of the many highlights was definitely the beautiful pool—an oasis of relaxation with plenty of seating and space to unwind. Whether you're lounging by the water or sipping your morning coffee on the deck overlooking the river, every moment here feels like a dream.
The attention to detail in the design and amenities is impeccable. The hosts were thoughtful and responsive, ensuring our stay was nothing short of perfect. I can’t recommend this place highly enough—it’s the ideal getaway for anyone looking to experience both comfort and style in a truly unique setting. Thank you so much Garrett and Laura!
Beautiful house in a stunning setting!

I recently stayed at this beautiful house upstate, and it was an incredible experience from start to finish. The highlight of the property was undoubtedly the amazing pool, which provided the perfect setting for relaxation and fun. The house itself was fully equipped with everything we needed, making our stay comfortable and convenient. The host was extremely responsive and attentive, ensuring that all our needs were met promptly. Overall, this place exceeded our expectations, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing getaway.

Outstanding home where we were able to host a weekend birthday retreat with 8 other friends. Lots of spaces for people to hang out and also have their space. The property is stunning snd so easy to get to from the city.
Everyone loved it and would gladly book again

The house is fabulous. Just as beautiful as the pics. The dogs loved the huge yard, and the pool and outdoor lounge space was gorgeous. The kitchen is easy to navigate and well stocked. The beds are very comfortable. The sound of the train is notable, but we were fine with it. We were there for a multi generation family vacation and the space worked great for that (older family members needed some assistance with the outdoor stairs, but that was doable).

Amazing Airbnb in an absolutely stunning location overlooking the Hudson River. Felt private while still just a few minutes drive from civilization should you need anything. Large and beautifully designed home with lots of great artwork. Everything was clean and exactly as pictured. Great amenities and the pool was gorgeous. Host was nice and quick to respond with any needs. One of the best Airbnbs that I have stayed in. We stayed with 2 adults + 2 kids + 2 grandparents & a dog and had plenty of space. The family had a wonderful week together in this fantastic home. Would definitely stay again and can highly recommend.

The house and it’s surroundings are beautiful. It was easy to communicate and Laura was very responsive to our questions. The house was organized and had everything we needed for the week. The bathrooms are a bit outdated but it met all of our needs. You won’t regret your time spent at this house!

Laura was very responsive prior to and during our stay and was super helpful.
The highlight of the property is the patio and pool area as well the views. There is a railroad line that runs along the water that can be noisy when they use the horn but it didn't bother us all that much. The interior is dated but that's the style of the house.
The house is close to a shopping center for last minute things but remote enough to be private. It's a quick ride to Beacon which is great too.
All in all would def stay again!

This home was amazing. We were staying here for a week with family - adults, teens, and toddlers. All coming not far from Brooklyn and Queens. We were already familiar with the area and others surrounding it and had plans to go to DIA, storm king, and the Newburgh Art Weekend.
The home was clean, quiet, and well air conditioned. The view was amazing. And the home had all the right comforts and rooms needed for a mix of chilling, fun and games, and family bonding time. The sun room was particularly great for our toddlers to play “outside” but kept inside during the heatwave.
The upstairs banister railing though has very wide bars. So if you have toddlers at that stage under 2yo it was not safe and pretty scary. We mostly had them in the sun room, downstairs, or outside by the pool. I was prepared by seeing this in the photos but just a word of caution.
We would stay again! Thank you!

The house was perfect for our family get together. It was fully stocked with everything we needed. The pool and the view were the highlights. We spent many hours in and beside the pool each day. Made great memories and would highly recommend!

Our stay at Garret and Laura's place was amazing. The kids loved the pool and I enjoyed the spectacular view. The place was very comfortable and clean. Everything went smooth from check-in to check-out. Thank you!
Great place, great pool, great view

We truly loved our stay and did not want to leave. The house, yard, and views were all beautiful. The photos do not do this place justice! The neighborhood is peaceful and secluded yet there are multiple restaurants and shops anywhere from 5-10 mins away. We spent most of our time in the sunroom looking out at the view or lounging outside by the pool. We look forward to coming back in the future.

The house is absolutely gorgeous, and the location is stunning. It looked exactly like the photos. Laura and Garrett were very responsive and incredibly helpful before and during our stay. I would definitely stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay at Hudson House! The hosts were extremely responsive to messages, and everything went smoothly. The care they take in making the home comfortable for guests shows!! Great place, incredible design, and amazing views. Two thumbs up; we will be coming back!!
